AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: Messaging app with a fixed set of contacts that records sent messages. Operational Patterns: - sendMessage sends one text message to one contact per call. Constraints: - The available contacts are トム (Tom), 花子 (Hanako), and 健太 (Kenta). Pass one of these names exactly; map honorifics or nicknames (e.g. トムくん) to the closest listed name. - Messages are only recorded in the app and are not delivered to real people.
